desc: Initialize frequency maps and duplicate pair counters for the initial left (indices 0,1) and right (indices 3 to n-1) partitions.
Iterate through each valid middle index `i` from 2 to `n-3`, computing the counts of the four pair types for both sides in $O(1)$ using current frequencies.
Accumulate the answer by summing products of left and right pair counts that satisfy the unique middle mode condition, applying modulo at each step.
Update the frequency maps and duplicate counters by moving `nums[i]` from the middle to the left partition and `nums[i+1]` from the right partition to the middle for the next iteration.
Return the final accumulated answer modulo $10^9 + 7$.
